title: Brown Gravy

ingredients.text: salt and whole pepper to taste

instructions: Brown the sliced onions in butter with the diced beef and bacon. Season and add a teacupful of water; cook until brown.
Add the remaining water and simmer gently for one and a half hours. Strain and skim the fat.
Brown the butter and flour, then stir into the strained gravy and bring to a boil.
author: Isabella Beeton, The Book of Household Management (1861)

title: Brown Onion Sauce

ingredients.text: a little more than 1/2 pint gravy

instructions: Slice and fry the onions in butter until lightly brown, stirring to prevent burning.
Add the gravy and simmer until tender.
Skim the fat, season and press through a sieve.
author: Isabella Beeton, The Book of Household Management (1861)
